description: Facts about the user and their notes, as extracted facts (#66) and knowledge-base notes (#65) store them: short, declarative, often about people. Several facts share a person or a theme so the query has to pick the right one.

documents.text: Jordan Hale is the user. Jordan is 34 and lives in Oakland, California.
Jordan's partner is Alex Moreno. They have been together since August 2021.
Alex works as a landscape architect at a firm in Emeryville and bikes to work.
Jordan is allergic to shellfish: shrimp, crab, lobster, clams, mussels and scallops. Fish is fine.
Jordan's dog Biscuit is a five-year-old beagle mix, 32 pounds, adopted from the Oakland Animal Services shelter.
Biscuit's vet is Dr. Okafor at Temescal Animal Clinic.
Jordan's father, Wen Hale, turns 70 on December 12, 2026. He is a retired high school chemistry teacher in Sacramento.
Jordan's mother, Linda Hale, ran the family restaurant, Hale's Kitchen, in Sacramento for 22 years before selling it in 2023.
Jordan's sister Mei is a nurse in Portland and has two kids, Theo (7) and June (4).
Jordan prefers short answers in the morning and is happy to talk things through at length in the evening.
Jordan drinks oat milk flat whites and stops caffeine after 2 pm on good days.
Jordan runs on Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday and Sunday mornings around Lake Merritt.
Jordan's half marathon personal record is 2:07:40, set at a race in Sacramento in 2024.
Jordan studied economics at UC Davis and graduated in 2014.
Before Larderly, Jordan was an operations analyst at a food delivery company for three years.
Jordan's best friend is Sam Okoye, a chef who runs the kitchen at a restaurant in the Mission. They met in college.
Jordan's favorite cuisine is Sichuan, and the go-to spot for a celebration is a dumpling house in Oakland's Chinatown.
Jordan is learning Spanish with a tutor named Lucía, on Tuesdays at 7 pm, and has a 140-day streak on a language app.
Alex's family lives in Mexico City; Jordan and Alex plan to visit them in July 2027.
Jordan and Alex's anniversary is August 9.
Jordan's shoe size is US 10 and the running shoe model Jordan buys every time is a neutral daily trainer with a wide toe box.
Jordan's neighbor Sofia Lindqvist lives in the unit downstairs and has offered to look after Biscuit.
Jordan's doctor is Dr. Patel at the Rockridge medical office; the last physical was in March 2026.
Jordan drives a 2017 hatchback and has a mechanic on San Pablo Avenue the family trusts.
Jordan doesn't drink alcohol on weeknights and prefers non-alcoholic beer at work events.
Jordan finds investor meetings draining and likes to block 30 minutes afterwards to write notes.
Jordan's birthday is May 3.
Alex's birthday is February 18, and Alex has been hinting about wanting a ceramics class.
